# Create Arch Experimental node.
Creates an arch window for instancing. ### Radius Radius for the arch.
If this equals 0.5 \* "Width" the the arch is circular, otherwise pointed. ### Vertical Scale Scale the arch section vertically. ### Width The width of the window. ### Subdivs Number of points between the beginning of the arc and the apex. ### Horizontal space Space on each side of the window. ### Vertical Space Space above and below the window. ### Bottom Height The height of the lower (non-arch) part of the window. ### Extrude Depth How deep to extrude the window in. ## Tutorial
